'''2001 Iowa State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Des Moines, Iowa on 5 May 2001. [[Shawn Banwell]] won it. It is known from Shawn Banwell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2394">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-29-des-moines-ia-5-05-01d2394/ des-moines-ia-5-05-01], DeckTech (shawn "shawnof IA" banwell, 29 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-29-des-moines-ia-5-05-01d2394/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Des Moines, Iowa; Mayhem Collectibles, Des Moines, Iowa<ref name="tr-d2482" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Shawn Banwell]]
* '''Players:''' 32<ref name="tr-d2482" />
